name: Wallpaper Depth
description: Depth effect for static image wallpapers: a clock is drawn between the wallpaper and a cutout of its foreground, so scenery passes in front of it. Depth is estimated locally with Depth Anything V2 Small.
author: rip-rgh
permissions: Runs a local Python script that reads your wallpaper images and writes cutout PNGs and depth maps under ~/.cache/ambxst/depth
Needs a depth model file at ~/.local/share/ambxst/depth/model.onnx (downloaded manually, never fetched by the mod)
